svg.text: Formalizer — mandated subcoordinator · runs in the background across rounds · no overall time budget
only the decompose workers, the working swarm, and the lean code runner's swarm carry time limits · a round close never cuts the swarm

g.text: Idea reports — only after the hygiene linter
successful and unsuccessful · copied by the corresponding subcoordinators · no limit on number
decompose workers — one per pair
10 min per pair · unpaired reports move on after 10 min
overrun → cut → fragment region · outputs: decomposed fragments (lock this name)
+ the distribution plan for the working swarm
working swarm ~4 — purely mechanical (unrelated to the lean code runner's swarm)
decomposed fragments → single qmd file → lean code · does not run qmd-prover
similar lemmas / definitions / theorems / propositions placed closely
10-min cut: package the partial work → relay to a free worker (1-min wait) → else fragment region
30-min life, resumable in-window · 5-min tail → fragment region
lean code runner (lock this name)
wakes on every qmd update · resumable · never closes
plans the verification jobs in advance (prefers pieces that
shrink the goal node's distance) · dispatches them
lean code runner's own swarm — mechanical
whatever number the plan requires · no fixed count
runs the assigned lean code · counts the green theorems
reports green pieces + dependency edges · 30-min life
integrates the reported results
locks green pieces in the qmd (locked in place, never removed)
places the green lean code in the reliable idea set [Formalized]
builds and updates the dependency graph
reliable idea set [Formalized] (lock this name)
green lean codes are the only format · in the idea pool
citable as an established premise · un-overturnable
a copy lives in the question-routes folder
dependency graph (formalizer/dependency-graph.json)
every assumption is a node · green lean code is an edge
[Hired] flags · the goal node as a distinguished node
feeds the Producer's goal-frontier score

anything not well formatted · in the idea pool in the dossier
